# Derive API

- [Introduction](https://docs.derive.xyz/getting-started/introduction.md): How to interact with the Derive Exchange.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.derive.xyz/getting-started/quickstart.md): Make your first trade.
- [Programmatic Onboarding](https://docs.derive.xyz/getting-started/depositing.md): Integrate your app within minutes.
- [Contracts](https://docs.derive.xyz/getting-started/contracts.md): On-chain contract addresses and EIP-712 signing constants for the Derive v3 mainnet (Ethereum) and testnet (Sepolia) deployments.
- [Custom Bridges](https://docs.derive.xyz/getting-started/custom-bridges.md): The LayerZero bridges Derive runs for collaterals with no native Ethereum token.
- [Gasless Onboarding](https://docs.derive.xyz/getting-started/gasless-onboarding.md): Custom helpers Derive UX uses for onboarding.
- [Session Keys](https://docs.derive.xyz/authentication/session-keys.md): Delegated signing keys: create, edit, list, and their lifecycle.
- [Session Login](https://docs.derive.xyz/authentication/session-login.md): Authenticate a connection or request on behalf of a wallet.
- [Action Signing](https://docs.derive.xyz/authentication/action-signing.md): The EIP-712 scheme every state-changing action must carry.
- [Access Scopes](https://docs.derive.xyz/authentication/access-scopes.md): The two scope sets that bound what a session key may do.
- [Smart Contracts & Multi-sigs](https://docs.derive.xyz/authentication/contract-owned-accounts.md): Own and operate a Derive account from a multi-sig or smart contract on the Ethereum L1.
- [MPC Wallets](https://docs.derive.xyz/authentication/mpc-wallets.md): Restrict what an MPC wallet can do on Derive
- [Managers & Risk Universes](https://docs.derive.xyz/trading/managers-and-risk-universes.md): How margin managers and risk universes shape what a subaccount can trade and hold.
- [Orderbook Trading](https://docs.derive.xyz/trading/order-types.md): Limit and market orders, time-in-force, direction, order flags, trigger and algo orders, replace, and cancellation.
- [Market Maker Protection](https://docs.derive.xyz/trading/market-maker-protection.md): Auto-cancel a maker's MMP orders and quotes, and block new ones, when fills breach configurable thresholds within a rolling window.
- [Price Banding](https://docs.derive.xyz/trading/price-banding.md): How Derive bounds orderbook orders and RFQ quotes to a min/max price range using spot and volatility shocks, with shock values by currency.
- [Cancel on Disconnect](https://docs.derive.xyz/trading/cancel-on-disconnect.md): Automatically cancel a connection's MMP orders and quotes when its WebSocket connection drops.
- [RFQ Trading](https://docs.derive.xyz/trading/rfq.md): Request a quote on a multi-leg package, collect maker quotes, and execute the block atomically.
- [Transfers & Withdrawals](https://docs.derive.xyz/trading/transfers-withdrawals.md): Move collateral between subaccounts, to other wallets, and on-chain, plus transferring positions.
- [Instrument Names](https://docs.derive.xyz/trading/instrument-names.md): How spot, perp, and option instruments are named on the Derive v3 API.
- [Create a Vault](https://docs.derive.xyz/vaults/create-a-vault.md): Launch a vault in 3 minutes via the UX or SDK.
- [Fees](https://docs.derive.xyz/vaults/fees.md): How management and performance fees accrue, the high-water mark and benchmark assets, and the protocol fee share.
- [Process Deposits & Withdrawals](https://docs.derive.xyz/vaults/deposits-withdrawals.md): The request-and-settle flow: shareholders queue signed intents; the curator settles each by minting or burning shares at a quoted price.
- [Trade](https://docs.derive.xyz/vaults/trade.md): Trade the vault subaccount like any other subaccount.
- [Winddowns](https://docs.derive.xyz/vaults/winddowns.md): Close a vault: settle final withdrawals, force-burn remaining holders, and understand the terminal closed state.
- [Connecting over WebSocket](https://docs.derive.xyz/connecting.md): Open a session, send JSON-RPC frames, and keep the connection alive with heartbeats.
- [Subscriptions](https://docs.derive.xyz/subscriptions.md): Real-time WebSocket channels: subscribe to a list of channel names and receive server-pushed notification frames.
- [Rate Limits](https://docs.derive.xyz/rate-limits.md): The two-tier rate-limit model: per-wallet request-budget classes and the per-instrument order-rate limit.
- [Error Codes](https://docs.derive.xyz/error-codes.md): The JSON-RPC error shape and the full Derive v3 application error catalog.
- [JSON-RPC Envelope](https://docs.derive.xyz/json-rpc.md): The JSON-RPC 2.0 request/response envelope and the WebSocket and HTTP transports shared by every method.
- [private/change_subaccount_label](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/subaccounts/privatechange_subaccount_label.md): Updates the human-readable label for a subaccount. The label must be at most 16 characters, otherwise an invalid-params error is returned. Requires a signed session key with account-info scope; on success it echoes back the subaccount ID and the new label.
- [private/delete_subaccount](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/subaccounts/privatedelete_subaccount.md): Permanently deletes one of the caller's subaccounts via a signed action. The subaccount must be fully wound down: no balances or debt, no open orders, RFQs, or quotes, not a vault, not under auction, and not the wallet's fallback subaccount. Deletion never moves value; subaccount ids are never reuse…
- [private/get_all_portfolios](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/subaccounts/privateget_all_portfolios.md): Returns the complete portfolio (same shape as get_subaccount) for every subaccount owned by the given wallet, including valuations, margin figures, open orders, positions, and collaterals. If an individual subaccount's portfolio cannot be built, it is returned as a placeholder entry with failed_to_f…
- [private/get_collaterals](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/subaccounts/privateget_collaterals.md): Returns the subaccount ID and the list of its collateral balances, including each asset's amount and current value valued against live feed data. A lighter alternative to get_subaccount when only collateral holdings are needed.
- [private/get_margin](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/subaccounts/privateget_margin.md): Calculates net initial and maintenance margin for a subaccount before and after an optional simulated state change (position and/or collateral deltas), and whether that change would pass the margin requirement. Values are net margin — mark-to-market value minus the requirement — so positive means he…
- [private/get_positions](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/subaccounts/privateget_positions.md): Returns the subaccount ID and the list of its active positions, including size, mark price, average price, unrealized and realized PnL, and Greeks where applicable, valued against live feed data at request time. A lighter alternative to get_subaccount when only positions are needed.
- [private/get_subaccount](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/subaccounts/privateget_subaccount.md): Returns the complete portfolio for a single subaccount: its label, manager and risk-universe identifiers, margin type and liquidation status, aggregate valuation and margin figures (positions, collaterals, initial and maintenance margin, open-order margin) as decimal strings, plus the full lists of…
- [private/get_subaccounts](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/subaccounts/privateget_subaccounts.md): Returns the wallet address and the sorted list of subaccount IDs owned by that wallet. Yields an empty list if the wallet has no subaccounts.
- [public/get_margin](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/subaccounts/publicget_margin.md): Calculates net initial and maintenance margin for a fully simulated portfolio under a chosen margin type (SM or PM2; market selects the currency a PM2 manager must cover), optionally with a further simulated state change layered on top. Values are net margin — mark-to-market value minus the requirem…
- [public/get_subaccounts](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/subaccounts/publicget_subaccounts.md): Returns the wallet address and the sorted list of all subaccount IDs owned by that wallet. Yields an empty list if the wallet has no subaccounts. Public endpoint, no authentication required.
- [public/get_wallet](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/subaccounts/publicget_wallet.md): Returns the wallet address that owns `subaccount_id`; the reverse of `public/get_subaccounts`. Returns a subaccount-not-found error if the subaccount does not exist. The result can be up to 60 seconds old. Public endpoint, no authentication required.
- [private/edit_session_key](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/session-keys/privateedit_session_key.md): Updates an existing session key's label, IP allowlist, and/or off-chain scopes for a given wallet; it cannot change on-chain (protocol) scopes, for which you must re-register with private/set_session_key. Editing only the label needs account-info permission, while changing the IP allowlist or off-ch…
- [private/session_keys](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/session-keys/privatesession_keys.md): Returns every session key registered to the given wallet, including expired and not-yet-activated keys, each with its public address, scopes, expiry, label, IP allowlist, and permitted subaccounts.
- [private/set_session_key](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/session-keys/privateset_session_key.md): Authorizes a new session key for a wallet from a signed action, granting it a set of on-chain (protocol) scopes and off-chain scopes with an expiry, an optional label, an optional IP allowlist, and an optional list of subaccounts it may act on (defaults to all of the wallet's subaccounts). Send the…
- [private/set_session_key_debug](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/session-keys/privateset_session_key_debug.md): Takes the same params as private/set_session_key and rebuilds the session-key Action without executing anything, returning the EIP-712 encoded_data, encoded_data_hashed, action_hash, typed_data_hash, domain_separator, action_typehash, module, owner and expected_signer, plus the decoded session key,…
- [public/get_wallets_from_session_key](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/session-keys/publicget_wallets_from_session_key.md): Public lookup that returns the wallet addresses a given session key is registered to, sorted by expiry, with expired keys omitted. An optional scope filter narrows results to keys holding that off-chain scope; returns an error if no matching, unexpired keys exist.
- [private/get_account](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/account/privateget_account.md): Returns account-level information for a given wallet address: the list of its subaccount IDs, WebSocket rate limits (matching, non-matching, perp, and option messages per second) and any per-endpoint overrides, cancel-on-disconnect and RFQ-maker flags, the account creation timestamp, and a fee_info…
- [private/cancel](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privatecancel.md): Cancels one resting order identified by order_id, subaccount_id and instrument_name. Requires any trade scope on the session; returns the cancelled order with its final status.
- [private/cancel_algo_order](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privatecancel_algo_order.md): Cancels a single active algo order identified by order_id and subaccount_id, stopping any further child-order execution. Requires any trade scope; returns the cancelled order.
- [private/cancel_all](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privatecancel_all.md): Cancels every open order on the given subaccount. Optional cancel_trigger_orders and cancel_algo_orders flags additionally clear the subaccount's trigger and algo orders in the same call. Requires any trade scope; returns "ok" on success.
- [private/cancel_all_algo_orders](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privatecancel_all_algo_orders.md): Cancels every active algo order on the given subaccount. Requires any trade scope; returns "ok" on success.
- [private/cancel_all_trigger_orders](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privatecancel_all_trigger_orders.md): Cancels every pending trigger order on the given subaccount. Requires any trade scope; returns "ok" on success.
- [private/cancel_by_instrument](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privatecancel_by_instrument.md): Cancels every open order for a subaccount on a single instrument. Requires any trade scope; returns the number of orders cancelled.
- [private/cancel_by_label](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privatecancel_by_label.md): Cancels a subaccount's open orders that carry the given client label, optionally scoped to a single instrument_name. When an instrument is supplied the call is acknowledged with the number of orders cancelled; without one it runs as a bulk fire-and-forget cancel and returns a -1 sentinel count. Requ…
- [private/cancel_by_nonce](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privatecancel_by_nonce.md): Cancels a single order identified by its signing nonce, instrument_name and subaccount_id. The owning wallet is taken from the authenticated session rather than the request. Requires any trade scope; returns the cancelled order.
- [private/cancel_trigger_order](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privatecancel_trigger_order.md): Cancels a single pending trigger order identified by order_id and subaccount_id. Requires any trade scope; returns the cancelled order.
- [private/get_algo_orders](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privateget_algo_orders.md): Returns all active algo orders (e.g. time-sliced execution orders) for the given subaccount as a flat list. Read-only query.
- [private/get_open_orders](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privateget_open_orders.md): Returns all currently open orders for the given subaccount, including each order's instrument, direction, prices, amounts and status. Only orders resting on the order book are returned: pending trigger orders that have not yet fired are available from get_trigger_orders, and active algo orders from…
- [private/get_order](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privateget_order.md): Returns one order (active or completed) by order_id and subaccount_id; the subaccount filter enforces ownership. Returns the order or an order-does-not-exist error.
- [private/get_trigger_orders](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privateget_trigger_orders.md): Returns all pending trigger (conditional) orders for the given subaccount that have not yet fired. Read-only query.
- [private/order](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privateorder.md): Submits a signed limit or market order for a subaccount, specifying instrument, direction, amount, limit price and max fee, plus optional flags like time-in-force, reduce-only, post-only and MMP. The same endpoint also creates trigger orders (via trigger_type/trigger_price) and algo orders (via algo…

Byte-compa…
- [private/order_quote](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privateorder_quote.md): Dry-run pricing helper that estimates the outcome of a prospective order without placing it, returning projected fill price and amount, fees, pre/post initial margin, realized PnL, resulting order status and (where relevant) liquidation price and max tradable amount. All monetary values are returned…
- [private/replace](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/privatereplace.md): Atomically cancels a resting order (identified by order_id_to_cancel or nonce_to_cancel) and submits a replacement order in a single request. The payload is a full new-order specification plus the cancel target and an optional expected_filled_amount guard. Requires a signed order payload and Orderbo…
- [public/order_quote](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/orderbook/publicorder_quote.md): Public dry-run variant of order_quote that estimates fill price, fees, margin impact, projected order status and realized PnL for a prospective order without placing it, returning all values as decimal strings. Unlike private/order_quote it bypasses session scope checks, so it can be used to preview…
- [private/cancel_batch_quotes](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privatecancel_batch_quotes.md): Cancels all open quotes on a subaccount that match the supplied filters (any combination of quote_id, rfq_id, label, and nonce, applied together) in a single atomic operation. Omitting the optional filters targets all of the subaccount's open quotes. Returns the list of cancelled quote ids. Requires…
- [private/cancel_batch_rfqs](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privatecancel_batch_rfqs.md): Cancels all open RFQs on a subaccount that match the supplied filters (any combination of rfq_id, label, and nonce, applied together), cascade-cancelling their quotes. Omitting the optional filters targets all of the subaccount's open RFQs. Returns the set of cancelled RFQs. Requires an RFQ trade sc…
- [private/cancel_quote](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privatecancel_quote.md): Cancels one open quote owned by the subaccount, identified by quote_id (optionally further constrained by rfq_id, label, or nonce). Returns the cancelled quote, or a quote-not-found error if it does not exist or is no longer open. Requires an RFQ trade scope.
- [private/cancel_rfq](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privatecancel_rfq.md): Cancels one open RFQ owned by the given subaccount and cascade-cancels any quotes makers have submitted against it, notifying those makers. Identify the RFQ by its rfq_id. Returns "ok" on success. Requires an RFQ trade scope.
- [private/execute_quote](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privateexecute_quote.md): Taker-side call that accepts a specific maker quote and settles the trade atomically. You reference the rfq_id and quote_id and supply the taker's priced legs, direction, max fee, and EIP-712 signature (signer, signature, nonce, expiry), with an optional taker-protection flag. It does not check the…
- [private/get_maker_rfq_history](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privateget_maker_rfq_history.md): Maker-side history of RFQs the subaccount was eligible to quote, i.e. RFQs open to all makers or naming the maker's wallet as a counterparty, including ones the maker never quoted. Returns filled, cancelled and expired RFQs only; use private/poll_rfqs for open ones. Supports filtering by rfq_id, sta…
- [private/get_quotes](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privateget_quotes.md): Returns a paginated, merged view of a subaccount's quotes, combining currently open quotes with the archived history of filled, cancelled, and expired ones. - [private/get_rfqs](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privateget_rfqs.md): Returns a paginated, merged view of a subaccount's RFQs, combining currently open RFQs with the archived history of filled, cancelled, and expired ones. Supports filtering by rfq_id, status, and a from/to timestamp window, with page and page_size controls. Each entry includes legs, status, timestamp…
- [private/poll_quotes](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privatepoll_quotes.md): Taker-side call that lists the maker quotes received against RFQs owned by the subaccount. Supports filtering by quote_id, rfq_id, status, and a timestamp window, with pagination. Returns public quote views (including the maker's wallet) without any signing material.
- [private/poll_rfqs](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privatepoll_rfqs.md): Maker-side call that lists the RFQs a subaccount is eligible to quote, i.e. RFQs that are open to all makers or that name the maker's wallet as a counterparty. Supports filtering by rfq_id, status, an originating RFQ subaccount, and a timestamp window, with pagination. Returns public RFQ views witho…
- [private/replace_quote](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privatereplace_quote.md): Maker-side call that atomically cancels an existing quote and submits a new signed quote for the same RFQ in one operation. You provide the new priced legs, direction, max fee, and EIP-712 signature, plus the quote to cancel (by quote_id or nonce_to_cancel). Returns the cancellation result together…
- [private/rfq_get_best_quote](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privaterfq_get_best_quote.md): Taker-side dry run that evaluates a prospective RFQ (its legs and intended direction) without creating anything. Returns the best available maker quote if one exists. It returns no quote when the best quote breaks the RFQ's max_total_cost or min_total_cost. The response also includes the expected fe…
- [private/send_quote](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privatesend_quote.md): Maker-side call that submits a priced, signed quote in response to an existing RFQ. You provide the priced legs, direction, max fee, an EIP-712 signature (signer, signature, nonce, expiry), and optional label or MMP flag. The quote's signature is verified and validated against the referenced RFQ bef…
- [private/send_rfq](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/privatesend_rfq.md): Taker-side call that opens a new RFQ for a multi-leg structure on a subaccount, inviting makers to quote it. - [public/send_quote_debug](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/rfq/publicsend_quote_debug.md): Public signing-preview helper that returns the EIP-712 encoding artifacts (encoded data, its hash, the action hash, and the typed-data hash) for a maker quote a client is about to sign. - [private/liquidate](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/liquidations/privateliquidate.md): Bids on an open liquidation auction. Names the bidder's own subaccount, the account being auctioned, the fraction of it to absorb as a whole percent (a multiple of 0.01), and a signed limit price. - [public/get_live_auctions](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/liquidations/publicget_live_auctions.md): Returns every liquidation auction open right now, each priced for a maximal bid at the moment of the response: the cash a bid would cost, the largest fraction of the account it could take, the account's mark-to-market value, the expected discount profit, and the balances on offer. Takes no parameter…
- [public/margin_watch](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/liquidations/publicmargin_watch.md): Calculates the mark-to-market value and initial/maintenance margin for a given subaccount, with per-position and per-collateral breakdowns, computed from live feed data at request time. Margins use the subaccount's manager's params. Set is_delayed_liquidation to get them under the subaccount's delay…
- [private/cancel_all_vault_requests](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-shareholders/privatecancel_all_vault_requests.md): Submits a signed cancel action that drains all of the caller's pending deposit and withdraw requests for a given vault and posts the corresponding on-chain operation. Input is the vault subaccount; any subaccount the caller owns may sign. Requires the user-cancel permission.
- [private/get_live_vault_requests](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-shareholders/privateget_live_vault_requests.md): Returns the caller's currently-pending vault deposit and withdraw requests, read live from the vault queue. Not paginated (the live queue is bounded); settled and terminal history is served by get_vault_request_history. The wallet parameter must match the authenticated connection.
- [private/get_shareholder_vaults](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-shareholders/privateget_shareholder_vaults.md): Returns the subaccount ids of the vaults in which the given wallet holds shares. The wallet parameter must match the authenticated connection. Read-only.
- [private/get_vault_request_history](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-shareholders/privateget_vault_request_history.md): Returns the caller's full vault action history (deposits, withdrawals, force-withdrawals, and cancels) across every status — enqueued, requested, applied, cancelled, rejected, or expired — with one row per action at its latest state. Paginated by page and page_size; monetary amounts, prices, and sha…
- [private/get_vault_shares](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-shareholders/privateget_vault_shares.md): Returns the caller's share balance for every vault it holds shares in, each paired with the full enriched vault row (the same shape as public/get_vault). The wallet parameter must match the authenticated connection. Read-only.
- [private/request_vault_deposit](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-shareholders/privaterequest_vault_deposit.md): Submits a signed deposit action from the user's source subaccount and enqueues it in the vault's pending-deposit queue for the curator to settle. Inputs are the target vault subaccount, the deposit asset, and the amount as a decimal string. Returns an acknowledgement with the queued request; require…
- [private/request_vault_withdraw](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-shareholders/privaterequest_vault_withdraw.md): Submits a signed withdraw action that enqueues a request to burn a given number of vault shares and redeem the proceeds to the user's subaccount. Inputs are the vault subaccount and the share quantity to burn (decimal string). Returns an acknowledgement with the queued request; requires the user-wit…
- [public/get_vault](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-shareholders/publicget_vault.md): Returns the full vault record — on-chain state plus curator metadata — for one vault subaccount id. Unauthenticated and read-only.
- [public/get_vault_action_history](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-shareholders/publicget_vault_action_history.md): Returns a vault's finalized deposit, withdrawal, fee-accrual, and cancel events — including NAV, share price, high-water mark, and the fee-share split across management, performance, curator, and protocol — at the vault level (per-holder position details are omitted). Inputs are the vault subaccount…
- [public/get_vault_performance_history](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-shareholders/publicget_vault_performance_history.md): Returns a time series of a vault's mark-to-market performance (NAV, share price, total and curator shares, high-water mark, optional benchmark) sampled hourly and downsampled to the requested resolution (1h, 8h, 24h, or 1wk). Supports optional from/to unix-second bounds and a limit (newest first, de…
- [public/get_vaults](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-shareholders/publicget_vaults.md): Returns every vault in the system, each paired with its subaccount id, paginated by page and page_size. Unauthenticated and read-only.
- [private/burn_vault_shares](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-curators/privateburn_vault_shares.md): Curator-only endpoint that settles a pending withdraw request by signing a burn approval at a quoted share price (USD per share). Takes the request id and the user's withdraw-action hash, burns the shares, and returns the settlement result. Requires the curator mint-and-burn permission.
- [private/create_vault](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-curators/privatecreate_vault.md): Registers a new vault on-chain from a signed action; the signing wallet becomes the vault's curator and seeds the initial deposit from its funding subaccount. Inputs set the deposit asset, initial deposit amount, initial share price, management/performance fee rates (in basis points), max slippage,…
- [private/force_burn](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-curators/privateforce_burn.md): Curator-signed endpoint that builds an on-chain action to forcibly redeem a given holder's entire share balance at the current mark-to-market share price. - [private/get_curated_vaults](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-curators/privateget_curated_vaults.md): Returns the subaccount ids of the vaults curated by the given wallet. The wallet parameter must match the authenticated connection. Read-only.
- [private/get_live_burn_requests](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-curators/privateget_live_burn_requests.md): Curator-only endpoint that returns a FIFO page of a vault's pending withdraw (burn) requests. Inputs are the vault subaccount and a page limit. Requires the curator mint-and-burn permission.
- [private/get_live_mint_requests](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-curators/privateget_live_mint_requests.md): Curator-only endpoint that returns a FIFO page of a vault's pending deposit (mint) requests. Inputs are the vault subaccount and a page limit. Requires the curator mint-and-burn permission.
- [private/mint_vault_shares](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-curators/privatemint_vault_shares.md): Curator-only endpoint that settles a pending deposit request by signing a mint approval at a quoted share price (USD per share). Takes the request id and the user's deposit-action hash, mints the corresponding shares, and returns the settlement result. Requires the curator mint-and-burn permission.
- [private/reject_deposit_request](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-curators/privatereject_deposit_request.md): Curator-only endpoint that removes a queued deposit request off-chain (no on-chain settlement), recording the rejection with an optional short reason. Takes the request id and returns an acknowledgement. Requires the curator mint-and-burn permission.
- [private/update_vault_info](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/vault-curators/privateupdate_vault_info.md): Applies an off-chain patch to a vault the caller curates, updating any of its display name, description, advisory mark-to-market cap (a USD decimal), or whitelist-only flag. Only the fields supplied are changed. The caller must own the vault's subaccount (i.e. be its curator); description length is…

- [public/getRateLimits](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/system/publicgetratelimits.md): Returns the caller's current remaining rate-limit allowances for the active connection, broken out into matching-request, non-matching-request, and per-endpoint buckets. Takes no parameters. A resolved incident disappears from this list.
- [public/get_time](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/system/publicget_time.md): Returns the current server time in milliseconds since the UNIX epoch. Takes no parameters and requires no authentication. Use it to align the timestamps and nonces bound into signed actions with the server clock.
- [public/get_transaction](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/system/publicget_transaction.md): Looks up the settlement lifecycle of a previously submitted operation by its operation UUID (op_uuid). Returns the operation's serialized data along with its batch status, settlement transaction hash, and any error log; the status is null until the operation has been picked up for settlement.

Returns a per-channel status map ("ok" or an error string) plus the subscriptions that remain after the call.

- [Auctions watch](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/auctionswatch.md): Channel name: `auctions.watch`. Public channel that streams the live state of all ongoing liquidation and insolvency auctions across the exchange. Takes no parameters.
- [Margin watch](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/marginwatch.md): Channel name: `margin.watch`. Public channel that streams margin and mark-to-market state for all accounts, letting you monitor collateralization and liquidation risk across the exchange. Takes no parameters.
- [Orderbook](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/orderbook.md): Channel name: `orderbook.{instrument_name}.{group}.{depth}`. Public channel that periodically publishes aggregated bids and asks for a single instrument, where {instrument_name} is the market (e.g. ETH-PERP), {group} is the price-level aggregation size (1, 10, or 100), and {depth} is the number of l…
- [Spot feed](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/spotfeed.md): Channel name: `spot_feed.{currency}`. Public channel that streams the spot price feed for a given underlying, where {currency} selects the asset (e.g. ETH or BTC).
- [Subaccount balances](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/subaccountbalances.md): Channel name: `{subaccount_id}.balances`. Private channel (requires authentication) that streams balance and position updates for one of your subaccounts, where {subaccount_id} is the numeric subaccount identifier.
- [Subaccount best quotes](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/subaccountbestquotes.md): Channel name: `{subaccount_id}.best.quotes`. Private channel (requires authentication) that streams best-quote updates relevant to your subaccount, where {subaccount_id} is the numeric subaccount identifier.
- [Subaccount orders](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/subaccountorders.md): Channel name: `{subaccount_id}.orders`. Private channel (requires authentication) that streams live order updates (opens, fills, cancels, and status changes) for your subaccount, where {subaccount_id} is the numeric subaccount identifier.
- [Subaccount quotes](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/subaccountquotes.md): Channel name: `{subaccount_id}.quotes`. Private channel (requires authentication) that streams updates to your RFQ quotes for a subaccount, where {subaccount_id} is the numeric subaccount identifier.
- [Subaccount trades](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/subaccounttrades.md): Channel name: `{subaccount_id}.trades`. Private channel (requires authentication) that streams your subaccount's own trade fills as they occur, where {subaccount_id} is the numeric subaccount identifier.
- [Ticker slim](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/tickerslim.md): Channel name: `ticker_slim.{instrument_name}.{interval}`. Public channel that streams a lightweight ticker (prices and key stats) for an instrument, where {instrument_name} is the market and {interval} is the update cadence in milliseconds (100 or 1000).
- [Trades by instrument](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/tradesbyinstrument.md): Channel name: `trades.{instrument_name}`. Public channel that streams the public trade tape for a single instrument, where {instrument_name} is the market whose fills you want to follow.
- [Trades by instrument type currency](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/tradesbyinstrumenttypecurrency.md): Channel name: `trades.{instrument_type}.{currency}`. Public channel that streams public trades filtered by market category, where {instrument_type} is the kind of instrument (erc20, option, or perp) and {currency} is the underlying asset (e.g. ETH or BTC).
- [Wallet rfqs](https://docs.derive.xyz/api-reference/channels/walletrfqs.md): Channel name: `{wallet}.rfqs`. Private channel (requires authentication) that streams RFQ (request-for-quote) updates for all subaccounts under a wallet, where {wallet} is your wallet address.

- [Perpetuals](https://docs.derive.xyz/perpetuals.md)
- [Interest Rate Model](https://docs.derive.xyz/interest-rate-model.md)
- [Integrators and Market Makers](https://docs.derive.xyz/integrators/introduction.md): Programs, fees, and API controls for teams building on Derive.
- [Builder Fees on Derive](https://docs.derive.xyz/integrators/programs/builder-fees.md): Charge an extra_fee on orders your users submit and receive it directly to your Derive Wallet on a 4-week cycle.
- [API Broker Program: Earn Fee Share on Referred Trades](https://docs.derive.xyz/integrators/programs/api-broker-program.md): Earn 10-50% of net exchange fees on every trade your referred users make. Referral codes attach to individual orders via the referral_code field.
- [Institutional Trading Rewards Program](https://docs.derive.xyz/integrators/programs/institutional-trading-rewards.md): Market maker rewards on Derive: up to $500K USDC and 1M DRV per 28-day epoch, allocated by score, volume, and stDRV holdings.
- [Trading Fees on Derive: Maker, Taker, RFQ, and Liquidation](https://docs.derive.xyz/integrators/trading/trading-fees.md): Orderbook and RFQ fee schedules for spot, perps, and options on Derive, plus liquidation fees and USDC interest.
- [Rate Limits for Integrators and Market Makers](https://docs.derive.xyz/integrators/trading/rate-limits.md): How the V3 rate-limit tiers apply to integrators, plus increased matching-engine limits for approved market makers.
- [Market Maker Protections on Derive](https://docs.derive.xyz/integrators/trading/market-maker-protections.md): MMP configuration, cancel-on-disconnect, the mmp order flag, and open-orders margin: the safety net for programmatic traders.
- [Changelog](https://docs.derive.xyz/changelog.md): Release notes for the Derive API.
